questions.question: Which topics are explicitly covered in the Introduction to Marketing lecture? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture covers marketing strategy, market research, product management, digital marketing, brand management, and CRM.

questions.question: Which are objectives of the lecture? [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: B. Apply marketing strategy in digital environments
C. Analyze customer data for decision-making
D. Connect IT skills with marketing applications
E. Eliminate the need for customer research

questions.explanation: The lecture objectives focus on understanding modern marketing, applying strategy digitally, analyzing customer data, and connecting IT with marketing.

questions.question: Why should computing students learn marketing? [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: A. Technology does not sell itself
B. Software products can fail because of poor market fit
C. Marketing is relevant to tech entrepreneurship
D. Every software product automatically gains users

questions.explanation: Computing students need marketing knowledge because technology alone does not guarantee adoption, poor market fit causes failure, and marketing supports entrepreneurship.

questions.question: Many student-developed mobile applications fail to gain users primarily because: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. They always use the wrong programming language
C. Mobile devices cannot support student applications
D. Customers never use new applications

questions.explanation: The lecture states that many student-developed apps never gain users because marketing is ignored.

questions.question: According to the lecture, marketing is best described as: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: C. A process of creating value
D. A process of communicating value
E. Only persuading customers to buy immediately

questions.explanation: Marketing is described as a human-centric and technology-enabled process of creating, communicating, delivering, and exchanging value.

questions.question: Which activities are part of the marketing process described in the lecture? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture identifies creating, communicating, delivering, and exchanging value as key parts of marketing.

questions.question: Marketing aims to achieve which outcomes? [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: A. Meeting customer needs and wants
E. Focusing only on one-time transactions

questions.explanation: Marketing focuses on meeting needs and wants, building relationships, creating customer value, and capturing value in return.

questions.question: Selling is primarily described as: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. A long-term process of building brand loyalty
B. An immediate transactional process of persuading a customer to buy
C. The process of analyzing customer data only
D. The process of developing new products only

questions.explanation: Selling focuses on the immediate transaction and persuading a specific customer to buy.

questions.question: Marketing differs from selling because marketing focuses on: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: E. Only completing an immediate transaction

questions.explanation: Marketing is strategic and long-term, involving customer needs, research, advertising, product development, and loyalty.

questions.question: Match the characteristics correctly. Which statements describe marketing rather than selling? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Marketing is customer-focused, long-term, and relationship-oriented.

questions.question: Before the 1960s, marketing was mainly: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: Before the 1960s, marketing was product-centric with a focus on efficiency and production.

questions.question: The main focus of marketing from the 1960s to the 1980s was: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: The 1960s–1980s represented a customer-centric era focused on satisfaction.

questions.question: Which period is associated with values-driven marketing and emotional connection? [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: The 1990s–2000s focused on values-driven marketing and emotional connection.

questions.question: The Digital Era of marketing is associated with: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: The 2000s–2010s Digital Era focused on engagement.

questions.question: The Data and AI Era mainly emphasized: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: The 2010s–2020s Data and AI Era focused on personalization.

questions.question: Marketing 6.0 is characterized primarily by: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Marketing 6.0 combines human understanding and technology to create advanced customer experiences.

questions.question: A marketing strategy is best defined as: [Select ONE]

answers.option: B. A long-term plan focused on customer value and competitive advantage
C. A method for reducing all marketing budgets
D. A replacement for customer understanding

questions.explanation: Marketing strategy is a long-term plan for creating customer value and achieving competitive advantage.

questions.question: Modern marketing strategy combines: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture emphasizes combining human understanding and advanced technology to deliver personalized, human-centered value.

questions.question: An effective marketing strategy should connect: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. High-level goals to tactical activities
D. Technology only to programming languages

questions.explanation: An effective strategy maps high-level goals down to tactical activities.

questions.question: A good marketing strategy ensures which elements support the company's long-term vision? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Campaigns, budgets, and assets should directly support the company's long-term vision.

questions.question: In the cloud-storage example, 'Become the safest cloud-storage platform for global finance firms' represents the: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: This statement represents the company's long-term vision.

questions.question: In the cloud-storage example, positioning the brand around military-grade encryption and targeting mid-sized banks represents: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: This is the strategy used to achieve the vision.

questions.question: Chief Information Security Officers at fintech companies with 50–500 employees represent the: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: This describes a specific target market.

questions.question: Publishing weekly whitepapers, running targeted LinkedIn advertisements, and attending cybersecurity expos represent: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: These are tactical execution activities supporting the strategy.

questions.question: The traditional marketing mix consists of which four elements? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The marketing mix consists of Product, Price, Place, and Promotion.

questions.question: Which marketing mix element answers 'What are you selling and why is it valuable to the consumer?' [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: Product concerns what is being sold and why it provides value.

questions.question: Pricing strategy should be considered in relation to: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Price is considered in relation to market demand and competitors.

questions.question: Which marketing mix element focuses on where a product is sold or distributed? [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: Place refers to where the product is sold or distributed.

questions.question: Promotion mainly concerns: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: B. Selecting channels to reach the audience
C. Determining where products are physically distributed only

questions.explanation: Promotion concerns how the message is crafted and which channels are used to reach the target audience.

questions.question: The STP Model stands for: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: STP stands for Segmentation, Targeting, and Positioning.

questions.question: The STP Model helps businesses: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: A. Divide a broad market into smaller groups
B. Select valuable groups to focus on
C. Create a clear message for specific customers
D. Treat every customer exactly the same

questions.explanation: STP divides markets, selects attractive segments, and creates clear positioning.

questions.question: Market segmentation means: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. Dividing the market into smaller groups

questions.explanation: Segmentation divides a broad market into smaller groups.

questions.question: According to the lecture, market segments can be based on: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture gives demographics, behavior, preferences, age, gender, and location as segmentation factors.

questions.question: Targeting involves selecting customer segments based on: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Targeting evaluates segments using profitability, needs, growth potential, size, and accessibility.

questions.question: Positioning is primarily about: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. Creating a unique image in the customer's mind
B. Dividing the market into groups

questions.explanation: Positioning creates a unique image of the product in customers' minds.

questions.question: Positioning focuses on which factors? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Positioning focuses on value, experience, and differentiation.

questions.question: A Customer Value Proposition (CVP) explains: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. Why customers should choose a product over competitors
B. How employees should be organized
C. How taxes should be calculated
D. How products enter the decline stage

questions.explanation: A CVP explains the unique value offered and why customers should choose the company over competitors.

questions.question: A strong CVP supports a smooth and consistent customer journey across: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: The lecture states that CVP supports consistency across all customer touchpoints using data and technology.

questions.question: Market research is the process of: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Market research involves collecting, analyzing, and interpreting information to support decisions.

questions.question: Market research commonly examines information about: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Market research examines customers, markets, and competitors.

questions.question: Market research helps organizations understand what people: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: E. Why they behave that way

questions.explanation: Research helps organizations understand what people need, want, think, do, and why.

questions.question: Which are examples of primary data sources? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture identifies surveys and interviews as examples of primary data.

questions.question: Which are examples of secondary data sources? [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: C. Interviews conducted specifically for the study

questions.explanation: Secondary data includes information from sources such as reports and databases.

questions.question: Data-driven decision-making through market research helps businesses: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Research insights improve decisions, reduce uncertainty, and strengthen marketing strategies.

questions.question: Digital research tools are primarily online technologies used to: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Digital research tools collect and analyze customer information.

questions.question: Examples of digital market research tools include: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture gives web analytics, social media insights, and online surveys as examples.

questions.question: Digital research tools can track which information in real time? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Digital tools can track behavior, preferences, and interactions in real time.

questions.question: Artificial Intelligence enhances market research by: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: C. Identifying patterns and trends quickly

questions.explanation: AI analyzes large datasets, identifies patterns, predicts behavior, and supports forecasting.

questions.question: AI-supported market research enables: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: AI enables predictive analytics, forecasting, personalization, and targeted marketing.

questions.question: Product management is the process of: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Product management involves planning, developing, and managing products to deliver value and meet changing customer needs.

questions.question: Product management uses which factors to continuously improve products? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Technology and customer information are used to improve products and experiences.

questions.question: Product management guides a product through which journey? [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. From initial idea to final release and beyond
B. From employee recruitment to retirement
C. From advertising directly to decline
D. From pricing to accounting only

questions.explanation: Product management guides the product from the initial idea through release and beyond.

questions.question: The question 'Does the customer need this?' is mainly associated with: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: Customer need is evaluated from the User Experience perspective.

questions.question: The question 'Can we build this?' mainly evaluates: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: This question evaluates technological feasibility.

questions.question: The question 'Does this make sense for the business?' relates to: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: This question evaluates whether the product makes sense from a business strategy perspective.

questions.question: Product decisions should be guided by: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Customer data, feedback, and usage patterns guide continuous product improvement.

questions.question: Advanced technologies and innovative features are incorporated mainly to improve: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Technology and innovative features improve functionality, usability, and user experience.

questions.question: Which approaches are explicitly mentioned for continuous product development and improvement? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture mentions Agile and MVP approaches supported by continuous testing, feedback, and updates.

questions.question: The Product Life Cycle (PLC) describes: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. Stages a product goes through from introduction to decline
B. Only the development process before launch

questions.explanation: PLC describes the stages from product introduction to decline.

questions.question: Which sequence correctly represents the Product Life Cycle? [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: The correct PLC sequence is Introduction, Growth, Maturity, and Decline.

questions.question: During the Introduction stage of the PLC: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: C. The market is necessarily saturated

questions.explanation: Introduction involves launching the product and creating awareness.

questions.question: During the Growth stage: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Growth is characterized by increasing sales and popularity.

questions.question: During the Maturity stage: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: C. The product has not yet been launched

questions.explanation: Maturity is associated with market saturation and high competition.

questions.question: During the Decline stage, sales may decrease because: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: C. Awareness is always being created for the first time

questions.explanation: Decline occurs when demand falls or new alternatives emerge.

questions.question: IT industry products are mainly: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: IT products are mainly digital solutions including software, applications, and platforms.

questions.question: Examples of IT products include: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture lists SaaS, mobile applications, and digital platforms.

questions.question: IT products emphasize which customer-related qualities? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: IT products emphasize usability, interface design, and user satisfaction.

questions.question: IT products remain relevant and competitive through: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Regular improvement using feedback, usage data, and analytics helps IT products remain competitive.

questions.question: Modern IT products can enhance convenience through: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: A. Personalized features based on user behavior

questions.explanation: IT products can personalize features and integrate with other systems and platforms.

questions.question: What should generally be the first step before launching a product according to the lecture activity? [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: Market research should be conducted before launching a product.

questions.question: Which STP component focuses on selecting the right customer group? [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: Targeting selects the most appropriate customer segment.

questions.question: Why is market research important before developing a product? [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: A. It helps understand customer needs
D. It guarantees success without a good product

questions.explanation: Research helps understand needs, reduce uncertainty, and make better decisions before product development.

questions.question: One major benefit of Agile in product management is: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. Continuous improvement through testing, feedback, and updates

questions.explanation: Agile supports continuous testing, feedback, updates, and improvement.

questions.question: Marketing 6.0 focuses on creating: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Marketing 6.0 focuses on immersive physical-plus-digital experiences enabled by technology and human understanding.

questions.question: The term 'phygital' means: [Select ONE]

answers.option: D. Digital products without human interaction

questions.explanation: Phygital refers to the combination of physical and digital experiences.

questions.question: In Marketing 6.0, IT acts as an enabler through: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: IT enables Marketing 6.0 through data, automation, personalization, integration, and CRM.

questions.question: Customer data for marketing analytics can be collected from: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: IT collects customer data from websites, apps, and social media for analytics.

questions.question: Marketing automation can: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: C. Use chatbots for instant support

questions.explanation: Automation supports prediction, recommendations, and instant chatbot support.

questions.question: Personalization in Marketing 6.0 can provide: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Personalization uses customer data to create tailored and unique experiences.

questions.question: Integration in Marketing 6.0 connects: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Integration connects digital and physical platforms to provide consistent interactions.

questions.question: CRM contributes to Marketing 6.0 by: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: CRM manages customer information and supports long-term relationships and loyalty.

questions.question: Immersive technologies used in Marketing 6.0 include: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: AR, VR, and metaverse technologies can allow customers to experience products virtually before buying.

questions.question: Real-time decision-making allows businesses to: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: B. Quickly adjust to customer behavior

questions.explanation: Real-time insights allow marketing to become dynamic and responsive.

questions.question: IT enhances customer experience by improving: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: IT can improve CX through speed, convenience, accessibility, 24/7 services, and instant communication.

questions.question: Digital marketing is the use of: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Digital marketing uses digital technologies, online platforms, technology, and data.

questions.question: Digital marketing aims to: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Digital marketing promotes products, engages customers, and creates personalized interactive experiences.

questions.question: Digital marketing encompasses marketing efforts that use: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. Electronic devices or the internet

questions.explanation: Digital marketing uses electronic devices and the internet to connect with customers.

questions.question: Key characteristics of digital marketing include: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Digital marketing supports two-way communication, real-time interaction, analytics, targeting, personalization, and seamless experiences.

questions.question: Which are examples of digital marketing channels? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture lists websites, search engines, social media, email, and paid advertisements.

questions.question: Digital marketing metrics are: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. Quantifiable data points used to measure online campaign performance

questions.explanation: Digital metrics are quantifiable data points used to track and evaluate campaign performance.

questions.question: Digital metrics help businesses: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: A. Understand audience interactions with the brand

questions.explanation: Metrics provide objective evidence for optimization, budgeting, and ROI improvement.

questions.question: Which are examples of digital marketing metrics? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: CTR, Conversion Rate, and Customer Acquisition Cost are examples of digital metrics.

questions.question: Brand management is the process of: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Brand management creates, maintains, and enhances identity, image, and value.

questions.question: Strong brand identity requires consistency in: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Brand identity requires consistent communication of the name, logo, message, and values.

questions.question: Brand consistency should exist across: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Consistent branding across digital and physical channels creates a recognizable identity.

questions.question: Brands build emotional connections and trust by aligning with customers': [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Aligning with customer values, needs, and lifestyles helps build trust and loyalty.

questions.question: Digital platforms and storytelling can use: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Digital platforms and content help brands tell stories and create meaningful interactions.

questions.question: Positive and personalized experiences across touchpoints can: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: B. Differentiate the brand from competitors

questions.explanation: Positive experiences increase perceived value and strengthen differentiation and brand equity.

questions.question: Brand equity is the value a brand adds to a product or service based on: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Brand equity comes from customer perceptions, trust, and experiences.

questions.question: Brand equity is built through: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: Awareness, trust, loyalty, positive experiences, emotional connections, and consistency strengthen brand equity.

questions.question: Experience-driven branding focuses primarily on: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: C. Customer experience at every touchpoint

questions.explanation: Experience-driven branding uses meaningful experiences, technology, and personalization to build engagement and loyalty.

questions.question: A clothing brand using Instagram and influencer marketing is primarily using: [Select ONE]
questions.explanation: Instagram and influencer marketing are forms of digital marketing.

questions.question: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) focuses on: [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: CRM manages and strengthens customer interactions to build relationships and loyalty.

questions.question: CRM uses which resources to build personalized long-term relationships? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: CRM uses data and technology to personalize relationships and improve loyalty.

questions.question: Which are objectives of CRM? [Select ALL correct answers]
questions.explanation: The lecture identifies retention, loyalty, CLV, and personalized customer experience as key CRM objectives.

questions.question: Customer retention focuses on: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. Keeping existing customers through consistent value and positive experiences
B. Focusing only on attracting new customers

questions.explanation: Customer retention aims to keep existing customers through consistent value and positive experiences.

questions.question: Customer loyalty is strengthened through: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: C. Encouraging customers to continue choosing the brand

questions.explanation: CRM builds loyalty through trust and emotional connection.

questions.question: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) refers to: [Select ONE]

answers.option: A. The total value a customer brings over time
B. The value of a single purchase only
C. The cost of developing one product
D. The company's total yearly revenue

questions.explanation: CLV aims to maximize the total value generated by a customer through repeated purchases and engagement.

questions.question: CRM tools are used to: [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: A. Store and organize customer information
E. Automate marketing, sales, and customer service tasks

questions.explanation: CRM tools manage customer data, personalize communication, automate tasks, and provide analytics for decision-making.

questions.question: Which statements correctly describe Customer Experience (CX)? [Select ALL correct answers]

answers.option: A. CX is the overall perception and feelings created through interactions with a brand
B. CX includes awareness, consideration, purchase, and post-purchase support
C. CX should be seamless and consistent across websites, apps, social media, and physical stores
D. CX combines functional, emotional, and digital experiences
E. Data, analytics, personalization, and AI can improve CX
F. CX only refers to the moment a customer purchases a product

questions.explanation: CX covers the customer's overall perception across all interactions and touchpoints. It combines functional, emotional, and digital experiences and is enhanced through customer data, analytics, personalization, technology, and AI.
